audit.lifecycle: CREATED -> AVAILABLE -> USED -> SETTLED (or EXPIRED / VOIDED)
audit.stakeAllocation: Consumes freebet_balance when placing bet with fundSource = 'freebet'
audit.winningSettlementRule: PROFIT_ONLY: Free bet stake is NOT returned to user on win. Only net profit (odds - 1) * stake is credited to cash balance.
audit.voidSettlementRule: On VOID, freebet stake is restored to freebet_balance if not expired
audit.doubleSpendProtection: Protected by database row-level locking on wallets (FOR UPDATE)
audit.campaignTargeting: Supports global campaigns and targeted segment campaigns via deposit_freebet_campaign_users
